'''Pilaan''' was one of the largest cities on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]].<ref name="Target" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] were sent there by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] to retrieve a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] from the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Mak Luunim]].<ref name="Target" />
